facts.value: Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Science
Many graduates advance their careers in medical and scientific research by enrolling in further studies at MSc and PhD level.
Several pursue Graduate Entry Medicine courses, at the University of Limerick or overseas.
Others have gone on to study Radiography and Veterinary Medicine.
Graduates have pursued careers in medical science in roles such as Laboratory Technicians in hospitals.
